description: This file contains functions related to handling failover policies, specifically for determining whether to allow, use, or preserve cooldown probe slots based on different failover reasons.

methods.name: export function shouldAllowCooldownProbeForReason( shouldAllowCooldownProbeForReason
methods.description: Determines if a cooldown probe is permitted for a given failover reason.

methods.name: export function shouldUseTransientCooldownProbeSlot( shouldUseTransientCooldownProbeSlot
methods.description: Checks if a transient cooldown probe slot should be used based on the reason.

methods.name: export function shouldPreserveTransientCooldownProbeSlot( shouldPreserveTransientCooldownProbeSlot
methods.description: Decides if a transient cooldown probe slot should be preserved given the reason.
